project_type: NestJS backend + Next.js 14 frontend + FastAPI AI microservice, PostgreSQL database
build_system: npm scripts for backend/frontend, uvicorn for AI service. Backend uses @nestjs/cli, frontend uses Next.js bundler
test_framework: Jest for backend (npm run test:watch), no frontend tests configured yet, AI service has no tests
build_command: Backend: cd backend && npm run build; Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build; AI: no build needed
test_command: Backend: cd backend && npm run test (or test:watch for specific suites); Frontend: none; AI: none
verification_instructions: 1. Start PostgreSQL on localhost:5432; 2. Start AI service: cd ai-service && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000; 3. Start backend: cd backend && npm run start:dev (port 3001); 4. Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev (port 3000); 5. Test flow: login → profile → resume → interview setup → interview room → report → history
snapshot_or_generated_files: Backend generates dist/ on build (not checked in). Frontend generates .next/ on build (not checked in). Database schema auto-synced via TypeORM synchronize:true in dev. No snapshot files to regenerate.
environment_constraints: AI_SERVICE_URL must be http://localhost:8000. DATABASE_URL must point to running PostgreSQL. JWT_SECRET required for auth. Never run with synchronize:true in production. @nestjs/axios package must be installed before HttpModule works. lucide-react must be installed before frontend icons work.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: NestJS modules export services needed by other modules; all interview endpoints require JWT auth except job-roles (marked @Public); ownership checks in services not controllers; use Repository pattern for database access; frontend uses axios interceptors for auth; match Tailwind styling from dashboard page.
key_patterns: Backend services: constructor injection of repositories and other services, async/await for all DB operations, throw NotFoundException/ForbiddenException/BadRequestException for errors. AI service: FastAPI routers with Pydantic models, stub implementations ready for LLM replacement. Frontend: 'use client' directive for client components, useEffect for data loading, api.get/post with try-catch, loading states during async operations. StudentProfile entity uses snake_case properties (user_id, technical_skills) unlike other entities - access via profile.user_id not profile.userId.
relevant_files: backend/src/resumes/resumes.service.ts (pattern reference for file handling and AI calls)
backend/src/app.module.ts (needs JobRolesModule, InterviewsModule imports, needs OnModuleInit for seeding)
ai-service/app/main.py (needs recommendations router import and registration)
frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx (styling and layout pattern, needs button update)
directory_structure: backend/src/{module-name}/{module-name}.module.ts, {module-name}.controller.ts, {module-name}.service.ts, dto/, entities/}. All entities in backend/src/database/entities/. Frontend pages in frontend/src/app/{route}/page.tsx. Frontend components in frontend/src/components/{category}/. AI service routers in ai-service/app/routers/, schemas in ai-service/app/models/schemas.py.
